# Daily Dashboard V0.5.5

Control Spotify on this computer and see track details and album cover without an API login. The calendar has a simpler toolbar and event hover previews over a softly obscured background.

- Music Settings offers Automatic (local first), Local Spotify only and Spotify Web API modes.
- Windows targets Spotify's own media session for supported playback, seek, shuffle and repeat actions. macOS uses Spotify scripting for playback, seek, volume and shuffle.
- Like/unlike and full controls use the optional paired Spotify client connector. Export it from Settings → Music, then follow the [Spicetify setup guide](https://github.com/BananaAficionado/DailyDashboard/blob/main/integrations/spotify/README.md). No Spotify installation is modified automatically.
- Unsupported controls are disabled. Failed local commands are not sent to remote devices through the Web API. Track/album text and cover stay in the widget; no Home or catalogue browsing is added.
- Calendar removes redundant branding, clock, refresh and source-rail space; week/work events keep their title, with time/location in the preview. Keyboard focus also opens previews; Escape dismisses them, and clicking pins the full detail dialog.
- Narrow weather metric cards use one column to keep labels and units inside the cards at high scaling.
- Work mode remains Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, with fitted collision-safe event subcolumns. Hide album art still expands music controls.

## Verification

Production build, frontend checks and nine Rust tests pass. Browser checks cover all six enabled widgets at four documented sizes across 19 resolution/scaling configurations (456 base combinations), plus Settings, keyboard, maps and short viewports. Dedicated checks cover 16 calendar hover configurations, local-only/automatic/API routing, connector Like/Shuffle/Repeat and unavailable native controls. The connector is tested with a mocked Spotify client; Windows SDK bindings are cross-compiled and CI builds the installer.

Real Spotify playback/Spicetify compatibility and a physical Windows upgrade need an on-device check. Close Daily Dashboard before installing over the previous version. The application identity and settings location remain unchanged.
